title: Whole, half and quarter turns
summary: Use position words and perform three-quarter and whole turns.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 reads a position scene. Q2 types how many quarter turns make a three-quarter turn. Q3 watches a three-quarter turn. Q4 orders the four turn sizes. Q5 taps every three-quarter name. Q6 predicts a three-quarter turn. Q7 performs a three-quarter turn. Q8 and Q9 type how the parts fit. Q10 performs a whole turn.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses position words, whole and half turns, supported quarter turns and one performed quarter turn. Medium varies starts and uses the clock-hand cue for both ways. Hard adds three-quarter turns and asks how the parts fit. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not only a bigger turn.
